verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Mt. Sinai.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṭūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والطور

verse_text_english: And the scripture that is recorded.
verse_text_arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wakitābin masṭūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكتب مسطور

verse_text_english: And published on paper.
verse_text_arabic: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fī raqqin manshūri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فى رق منشور

verse_text_english: By the frequented shrine.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-bayti l-maʿmūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والبيت المعمور

verse_text_english: With its high ceiling. . 6 By the vast ocean.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-saqfi l-marfūʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسقف المرفوع

verse_text_english: The sea that is set aflame.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-baḥri l-masjūr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والبحر المسجور

verse_text_english: The retribution from your Lord is a reality.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن عذاب ربك لوقع

verse_text_english: Nothing can stop it.
verse_text_arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mā lahu min dāfiʿi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما له من دافع

verse_text_english: That is the day when the heaven will violently thunder. . 10 The mountains will be erased.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tamūru l-samāu mawra
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم تمور السماء مورا

verse_text_english: The mountains will be wiped out.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: watasīru l-jibālu sayra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتسير الجبال سيرا

verse_text_english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verse_text_english: Who are heedless and playing.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين هم فى خوض يلعبون

verse_text_english: On that day, they will be herded to the fire of hell.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿa
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يدعون إلى نار جهنم دعا

verse_text_english: This is the fire that you used to deny.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذه النار التى كنتم بها تكذبون

verse_text_english: Is this magic, or do you not see? 16.
verse_text_arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفسحر هذا أم أنتم لا تبصرون

verse_text_english: Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.
verse_text_arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اصلوها فاصبروا أو لا تصبروا سواء عليكم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: As for the righteous, they have deserved gardens of bliss. 18.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى جنت ونعيم

verse_text_english: They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.
verse_text_arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكهين بما ءاتىهم ربهم ووقىهم ربهم عذاب الجحيم

verse_text_english: Eat and drink with blessings, in return for what you did. . 20 They relax on rows of furnishings, and we join with them magnificent spouses.*
verse_text_arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيـٔا بما كنتم تعملون

verse_text_english: They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.
verse_text_arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: متكـٔين على سرر مصفوفة وزوجنهم بحور عين

verse_text_english: For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. We never fail to reward them for any work. Every person is paid for what he did.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين ءامنوا واتبعتهم ذريتهم بإيمن ألحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما ألتنهم من عملهم من شىء كل امرئ بما كسب رهين

verse_text_english: We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأمددنهم بفكهة ولحم مما يشتهون

verse_text_english: They will share drinks that never run out and are never polluted.
verse_text_arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: يتنزعون فيها كأسا لا لغو فيها ولا تأثيم

verse_text_english: Serving them will be servants like precious pearls.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كأنهم لؤلؤ مكنون

verse_text_english: They will converse with each other.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون

verse_text_english: They will say, “We used to be humble among our people.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إنا كنا قبل فى أهلنا مشفقين

verse_text_english: “Then God showered us with His blessings and spared us the agony of ill winds.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن الله علينا ووقىنا عذاب السموم

verse_text_english: “We used to implore Him; He is the benign, the merciful.”
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كنا من قبل ندعوه إنه هو البر الرحيم

verse_text_english: You shall remind the people. With your Lord's blessings upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذكر فما أنت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون

verse_text_english: They may say, "He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead."
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب المنون

verse_text_english: Say, "Go on waiting; I will wait along with you."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل تربصوا فإنى معكم من المتربصين

verse_text_english: Is it their dreams that lead them to this, or is it wickedness?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم تأمرهم أحلمهم بهذا أم هم قوم طاغون

verse_text_english: Do they say that he made this up? They simply cannot believe.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون تقوله بل لا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: Let them show us a “hadith” (narration) like this, if they are truthful.
verse_text_arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فليأتوا بحديث مثله إن كانوا صدقين

verse_text_english: Were they created out of nothing? Could they be the creators?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقوا من غير شىء أم هم الخلقون

verse_text_english: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they are never certain.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقوا السموت والأرض بل لا يوقنون

verse_text_english: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control? 38.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم خزائن ربك أم هم المصيطرون

verse_text_english: Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? Let their listeners show their proof.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليأت مستمعهم بسلطن مبين

verse_text_english: Does God have daughters, while you have sons?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم له البنت ولكم البنون

verse_text_english: Are you asking them for a wage, so they are burdened thereby?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم تسـٔلهم أجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون

verse_text_english: Do they know the future and record it?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون

verse_text_english: Is it obstruction that they seek? The disbelievers only hinder themselves. 43.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يريدون كيدا فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون

verse_text_english: Do they have another god besides GOD? GOD be glorified, far above having partners.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم إله غير الله سبحن الله عما يشركون

verse_text_english: When they see masses falling from the sky, they will say, "Piled clouds!"
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يروا كسفا من السماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم

verse_text_english: Therefore, disregard them until they meet their day of doom. 46.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذرهم حتى يلقوا يومهم الذى فيه يصعقون

verse_text_english: On that day, their schemes will not protect them, nor will they be helped.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم لا يغنى عنهم كيدهم شيـٔا ولا هم ينصرون

verse_text_english: The wicked actually suffer retribution in this life, without realizing it.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون

verse_text_english: You shall steadfastly persevere in preaching the message of your Lord. You are in our eyes. And praise the glory of your Lord when you get up.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصبر لحكم ربك فإنك بأعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم

verse_text_english: Glorify Him during the night, and at dawn, as the stars fade away.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن اليل فسبحه وإدبر النجوم
